mapper.update: INSERT INTO patent (merge_key, patent_type, registration_number, application_date, title, url) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{patentType}, #{registrationNumber}, #{applicationDate}::date, #{title}, #{url}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO UPDATE SET patent_type = EXCLUDED.patent_type, registration_number = EXCLUDED.registration_number, application_date = EXCLUDED.application_date, title = EXCLUDED.title, url = EXCLUDED.url WHERE ( patent.patent_type, patent.registration_number, patent.application_date, patent.title, patent.url ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.patent_type, EXCLUDED.registration_number, EXCLUDED.application_date, EXCLUDED.title, EXCLUDED.url )

INSERT INTO company_patent (company_id, patent_id, inserted_at, deleted) SELECT c.company_id, p.patent_id, now(), false FROM company c JOIN patent p ON p.merge_key = #{mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, patent_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now() WHERE company_patent.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false
UPDATE company_patent cp SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cp.deleted = false AND cp.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} )
